intro: Friday brings compact search models, open Khmer typing tools and a new way to watch pull-request events. BC has paused the Massey Tunnel review, while fresh producer-price figures and a December security session offer more to follow.

stories.title: Atto explores smaller models for semantic search
stories.summary: NeuML introduced Atto, a family of compact models for dense, sparse and late-interaction retrieval. Its published comparisons let developers examine how model size affects search quality when choosing an embedding model for an application.

stories.title: Open models turn romanized Khmer into Khmer script
stories.summary: Samdei Type released transliteration models, training data and a human-checked benchmark. Its Apache-licensed Mini model has an on-device format; developers can also adapt pretrained checkpoints, though the team cautions that ambiguous spellings remain difficult.

stories.title: DaisyRose releases checkpoints for agent tasks
stories.summary: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, a model trained on long-running agent tasks, in three checkpoint formats under Apache 2.0. The team reports stronger terminal-task results than its Qwen base model, giving developers a model to evaluate independently.

stories.title: GitHub CLI can wait for pull-request events
stories.summary: GitHub CLI now supports event streams for pull requests, allowing scripts to wait for activity instead of repeatedly checking for changes. Options let developers follow events, wait for a set count or stop after a timeout.

stories.title: Massey Tunnel environmental review is paused
stories.summary: BC's Environmental Assessment Office paused its review of the Massey Tunnel replacement at the province's request during the government transition. The incoming government plans to review the tunnel and alternatives; the assessment office asked the project corporation to remain ready to resume.

stories.title: Metro Vancouver living-wage estimate rises to $28.55
stories.summary: Living Wage BC calculates that Metro Vancouver's living wage rose 70 cents to $28.55 an hour in 2026. The estimate accounts for household expenses, taxes and benefits across three household types, but excludes items such as debt payments and retirement savings.

meetups.date: 2026-12-04 · 2–4:30 p.m. · Planview Vancouver, 555 West Hastings Street, Suite 2360, Vancouver
meetups.title: Agent security meets prompt injection
meetups.description: Planview's platform engineering team hosts a discussion of prompt injection and the limits of conventional security filters for AI agents. The session covers layered defences, including gateways, guardrails and least-privilege access; register through the organizer.

meetups.date: 2026-12-05 · 9 a.m.–7 p.m. · Unit 400, 322 Water Street, Vancouver
meetups.title: Build and demonstrate an AI agent
meetups.description: Cognition and Keiki invite builders to create an agent around a business problem and present a working demo. Bring a laptop and an idea; registration requires host approval, and each team member must apply separately.

dining.date: 2026-12-09 · Fanny Bay Oyster Bar, 762 Cambie Street, Vancouver
dining.title: Learn oyster shucking at Fanny Bay
dining.description: Fanny Bay's new oyster masterclass returns in December, bringing a small group into the restaurant's Kelp Room to learn shucking from its seafood specialists. The restaurant has also introduced weekday food and drink features for fall and winter.
